sources.basis: Static inspection of the successor working-tree source identifies this implementation binding. It does not establish passing tests, installed availability, publication or engineering approval. Prior observations remain recoverable at 39be9c81.

placements.name: Local invocation diagnostics
constraints: Paths are relative to resolveLogConfig's selected directory. Defaults are XDG_STATE_HOME/rigorloop/logs or ~/.local/state/rigorloop/logs on the non-Windows/non-macOS branch, ~/Library/Logs/RigorLoop on macOS, and LOCALAPPDATA/RigorLoop/Logs with a home-directory fallback on Windows. These are inspected path selections, not cross-platform qualification.

An explicit absolute RIGORLOOP_LOG_DIR can select another containment root; the default user-state placement does not establish that every override lies outside the project. The source also uses an owned rotation lock beneath the selected root.

Only eligible observed invocations attempt diagnostic appends. Primary and advanced recording paths and retired-command admission bypass the generic logger. Explicit log lookup reads bounded retained files without rerunning the recorded command; logging may be disabled or degraded.
Diagnostic files are not authoritative operational records, recovery evidence, workflow approval, or a persistent agent runtime.
